validation_status: blocked-runtime: needs a Dory-enabled llama.cpp build (fork rev 98a74c97 / PR 30306); stock b12069 lacks the architecture
_notes: Looped nGPT: 72 GGUF blocks = 36 attention + 36 FFN; Input 8 / Recurrent 20 / Output 8 attention layers; pattern S-S-S-* (SWA window 1024, every 4th full attention). GGUF default num_loops 4 with per_loop KV (~3.5 GiB KV at 64K q8_0: does not fit with apps open).

Native controls: (1) loop count and KV mode via --override-kv on GGUF keys dory.num_loops (1-4) and dory.recurrent_kv_cache_mode (per_loop|last_loop), honoured only by a Dory-enabled runtime; (2) template kwargs enable_thinking (default true), medium_effort (appends '{reasoning effort: efficient}' to the last user turn; default false) and truncate_history_thinking (default true: drops past-turn reasoning). force_nonempty_content, which the README recommends for coding agents, is NOT referenced by the GGUF's embedded template (accepted and ignored here); preserve_thinking is not referenced either.

The vendor README runs flash-attn off with f16 KV. A q8_0 V cache requires flash attention: confirm the Dory build reports flash attention enabled; if not, this profile is invalid (f16 KV doubles the KV and needs a shorter context, recorded as a separate profile).
Sampling: vendor card and GGUF general.sampling: temperature 1.0, top_p 0.95 (README server example adds top_k 0, min_p 0). Pass --temperature 1.0 to run_candidate.
README: keep the whole expanded graph on the GPU (-ngl 999); this profile uses --gpu-layers all with mmap.
Vendor claims (BF16, not this Q5): SWE-bench Verified 50.3/59.5/61.8 at 1/2/4 loops vs Qwen3.5-9B 61.0.
